title: hippocrepis bourgaei var. commutata
intro: Hippocrepis bourgaei var. commutata, commonly known as Bourgae's broom or Bourgae's spurge glume-grass, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hippocrepis bourgaei var. commutata include bronchodilation, mucolytic and mucociliary clearance stimulation, and a reduction in inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
